backend.environment: Local MongoDB; uniquely named test databases
backend.warning: Starlette TestClient deprecates its httpx transport.

browser.environment: Next.js standalone production build and a dedicated QA database
journeys: Reference layout across desktop, tablet and mobile; local fonts; no student-layout page errors or overflow
Public registration, onboarding, fixed diagnostic save/skip/resume and report, mobile adaptive practice hint and feedback
Teacher fixed paper assignment, student submission, withheld grade, teacher close and release, student report
Admin mapped content publishing, pseudonymous CSV download, BKT predict/reveal and HiTSKT prediction with independent audit view
browser.resolved_findings: Password and shared select labels are explicitly bound to their inputs, independent of help text and embedded controls.

local_demo_smoke.windows_start_stop_restart: Passed after recording the executable paths supplied to the launcher. Both Lumen ports closed on stop, and the MongoDB listener retained the same process ID.
local_demo_smoke.example_common_diagnostic: Both students scored 8/12. Asha got 1/3 in fractions and 3/3 in equations. Rohan got 3/3 in fractions and 1/3 in equations.

limitations: Mathematics only. Live practice uses BKT; HiTSKT replay uses a separate mapped research fixture.
The dataset is synthetic; the checkpoint replay is interface evidence, not a claim about learning outcomes.
Password recovery transport was simulated in tests; live email requires an SMTP provider.
Local production verification does not establish a public deployment or a production school rollout.
